item: Row 386 (R811): a restore places a signer's key pair whole or not at all, refuses halves that do not match, and says what a key not placed means
summary: Custody and annotations sign with two files, <who>_ed25519.pem and <who>_ml_dsa_65.key (evidence is Ed25519 only, row 385). A restore could place one file of a pair alone, and the next signer then completed it with a new half of its own: a mixed identity. Now (1) a backup carrying only one half places neither (reason 'only one half of this key pair was in the backup; it is not written and stays in the backup', counted in lone_halves); (2) an ML-DSA file whose public key is not the one its secret key signs for (one sign-and-verify round trip through the app's own verifier, run only where the post-quantum library is installed) refuses both halves with 'the two halves of this key pair do not match; neither is written, and they stay in the backup'; Ed25519 public keys are derived, so they cannot mismatch; (3) a pair whose second placement loses a race to another caller takes the first half back, so no pair is left half ours; a write error still takes it back and fails the import as before; (4) when a signer's key is not placed and this install has no key of that signer, the keys report and the import report say 'This installation has no key named {name}, and the one in the backup was not placed, so records signed by it will show as "Signed by another installation"' (x12, each language quoting its existing R800 label); the restore never makes a key itself. Without the post-quantum library the round trip cannot run, so (two security reads) the file is checked with plain hashlib instead: FIPS 204 keeps tr = SHAKE256(public key) in bytes 64..128 of the secret key, so a foreign or swapped public key is refused there too (layout pinned against the real library in the PQC CI lane); an altered secret key is caught only where the library is. Also from the reads: a name a manifest lists twice places nothing of that pair ('the backup lists this key file more than once; no copy is written, and it stays in the backup', x12) instead of reading as a race; the mismatch is said on the ML-DSA file and the other half keeps its own reason; the note is shown when this install has no Ed25519 key of that signer; a placed half that cannot be looked at stops the import and is taken back. Tests: lone half with and without a local key, mismatch with and without the library, duplicate name, race, report and x12.
